gloss: no artificial coloring; free of added dyes

definitions.gloss: no artificial coloring; free from added dyes
definitions.explanation: A food label claim indicating that no artificial colorants or dyes have been added to a product. Commonly seen on Japanese food packaging alongside other natural/additive-free claims.

examples.japanese: {無着色|むちゃくしょく}の{食品|しょくひん}を{選|えら}ぶようにしている。
examples.english: I try to choose foods with no artificial coloring.

examples.japanese: このたらこは{無着色|むちゃくしょく}なので、{自然|しぜん}な{色|いろ}をしている。
examples.english: This cod roe has no artificial coloring, so it has a natural color.

examples.japanese: {無着色|むちゃくしょく}・{無添加|むてんか}の{商品|しょうひん}は{健康|けんこう}{志向|しこう}の{消費者|しょうひしゃ}に{人気|にんき}がある。
examples.english: Products with no artificial coloring or additives are popular among health-conscious consumers.

notes:
Compound of {無|む} (no; without) + {着色|ちゃくしょく} (coloring; dyeing). Frequently appears on food packaging as a label claim, especially on products like mentaiko, pickles, and processed meats where artificial coloring is sometimes added.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無着色|むちゃくしょく}の{食品|しょくひん}: food with no artificial coloring
- {無着色|むちゃくしょく}・{無添加|むてんか}: no artificial coloring or additives
- {無着色|むちゃくしょく}たらこ / {無着色|むちゃくしょく}{明太子|めんたいこ}: natural-color cod roe

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {無添加|むてんか}: no additives — broader claim covering all artificial additives, not just colorants
- {天然着色料|てんねんちゃくしょくりょう}: natural colorants — dyes derived from natural sources, not artificial
